message.content:
Yes—if you’re experiencing excessive or illegal noise in Atlanta, you can file a complaint with the city’s authorities. Here’s how: | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Contact | |------|------------|------------------------------| | **1** | **Identify the source** – Is it a neighbor, a business, a construction site, or a public event? Knowing this helps the city direct your complaint to the right department. | — | | **2** | **File a Noise Complaint Online** – Atlanta offers an online portal for reporting noise violations.
• Visit the **Atlanta Police Department’s “Report a Crime”** page:
• Select “Noise” from the list of crime types. | Online portal | | **3** | **Call the Atlanta Police Department** – If you prefer speaking directly or the issue is urgent, call 311 (or 911 for emergencies).
• 311 (non‑emergency)
• 911 (emergency) | Atlanta Police Department | | **4** | **Contact the City’s Code Enforcement Office** – For ongoing or repeated noise issues, especially from businesses or construction sites, the Code Enforcement Office can investigate and issue citations.
• Phone: (404) 656‑4000
• Email: code.enforcement@atlantaga.gov | City Code Enforcement | | **5** | **Reach Out to Your City Council Representative** – If you feel your complaint isn’t being addressed, you can contact your local council member. Each council member has a dedicated office.
• Find your representative here:
• Use the “Contact” link on the representative’s page. | City Council Office | | **6** | **Document the Noise** – Keep a log of dates, times, and descriptions. If possible, record audio or video evidence (respect privacy laws). This documentation can help the city enforce regulations. | — | ### Quick Tips - **Non‑Emergency Hotline:** 311 (for most noise complaints that don’t require immediate police response). - **Emergency Hotline:** 911 (if the noise is part of a larger emergency, e.g., a fire or violent incident). - **Online Reporting:** The online portal is often the fastest way to submit a formal complaint and receive a reference number. - **Follow‑Up:** After filing, you’ll usually receive a case number. Keep it handy for any follow‑up calls or emails. ### Legal Basis Atlanta’s noise ordinance is enforced under the **City Code § 10‑1‑1** (Noise). Violations can result in fines, and repeated offenses may lead to more serious penalties. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the city of Atlanta. Use the online portal, call 311, or contact the Code Enforcement Office or your city council representative for assistance.
